description: A Pages Router project that declares Next.js 13 without a lockfile, so the version is the lower bound of the range, outside the validated majors 14 to 16 (FS1041, FS1042), with a next.config.cjs that Next.js fails on (FS1043) and _app, which is no route (D-023, D-074, D-075). The manifest names the real next package, so the harness creates it at test time (Q-014).
